03How it fits

## Fourproducts,onecontinuousclaimfile.

Each product owns a stage of the file and hands off to the next. Together they read it, answer for it, watch it, and reach beyond it — so nothing in the claim goes unseen.

04Why Owl

## Builtforinsurance,notadaptedtoit.

A platform trained on the claim file — its documents, its taxonomies, its regulatory shape — not a prompt over a general model.

Insurance-native

Trained on claims documents and insurance taxonomies, not generic web text.

Live in weeks

Sits above your claims system and reads what lands — no rip-and-replace.

Fits your stack

Writes evidence back to Guidewire, Duck Creek, Origami, Snapsheet.

Line & lifecycle agnostic

Auto, WC, property, health, disability — one platform, every book.

Secure by design

SOC 2 Type II, HIPAA, encryption in transit and at rest.

Cited and auditable

Every output traces to the page it came from. One hundred percent cited.
